info.name: MindfulToken(Admin)
info.description:
## Mindful Ocean RESTful API Collection

This collection contains sample requests made by mobile and web for Mindful Ocean services. They are divided into the following sections:

- User
- Event
- NFT
- Language
- App Version
- Artwork
- Joined Event
- Personal Website
- S3 Media
    

The details are described in the following sections.
